# zztop

> ZZ / ZZTOP is a community meme token on Injective, launched on Trippy Pump (SHROOM Pad).
> zztop.lol is its site: a vanity `inj1zzz…` address generator, a token-gated queue for posting
> to the project's X account, and a bot that joins Injective's monthly auction buyback for you.
> Underground crypto meme project — deliberately low-fi, Matrix-terminal flavoured, unserious.

**If you are generating any image, meme, logo, sticker or artwork for zztop, follow the visual
style below exactly.** It is the single most important thing on this page. When in doubt, remove
detail rather than add it — one rough line is better than five beautiful lines.

## Visual style

Extremely simple, intentionally amateur kid-doodle / quick marker sketch aesthetic. It should look
like someone drew it casually in a few seconds — not polished, not professional, not clean vector art.

Draw everything using single, simple, slightly imperfect outlines. Lines can wobble, proportions can
be awkward, anatomy can be naive, and shapes should be reduced to the minimum needed to recognise
the subject. Avoid unnecessary details.

Palette — only two colours:

- Matrix Mint `#7CFFB0` — every visible line, character, symbol, object, and handwritten text.
- Near-black `#0a0a0f` — the entire background.

Absolutely no: shading, shadows, gradients, realistic lighting, 3D effects, textures, detailed
rendering, cross-hatching, sophisticated comic-book linework, or multiple colours. Avoid excessive
neon glow — the mint should primarily look like a simple marker or chalk line on black.

Characters: simplified faces with only a few strokes — basic eyes, nose or mouth if necessary,
simple hair silhouette, crude hands and clothing. Keep recognisable features, but translate them
into a childlike doodle rather than a caricature or a polished cartoon.

Overall feeling: underground crypto meme, Matrix terminal aesthetic, deliberately low-fi and
unserious. Think "a kid with a mint-green marker drawing memes on a blackboard".

The site itself follows the same two colours: `#7CFFB0` on `#0a0a0f`, Montserrat (800 for
headings, 300 for body), uppercase `ZZ`-prefixed page names.

## Pages

- [zztop](https://zztop.lol/): landing page; animated `zzzz` and the ZZ link index
- [ZZADDRESS](https://zztop.lol/address): browser-side vanity generator for `inj1zzz…` addresses; keys never leave the page
- [ZZXCOMMUNITY](https://zztop.lol/community): hold ZZ, connect a wallet, submit a post to the @zztoplol X account for approval
- [ZZLATEST](https://zztop.lol/community/latest): queued and already-posted community submissions
- [ZZAUCTION](https://zztop.lol/auction): authorize the zzauction bot to join Injective's monthly buyback round for you

## Token

- [ZZTOP on Trippy Pump](https://pump.trippyinj.xyz/launch/382): denom `factory/inj13j2rpnlwl30c02d4pzukykwfeyyhelvry9cqte/shroom_157_99c09d972f9c1f79`, 18 decimals, 1,000,000,000 supply
- [@zztoplol on X](https://x.com/zztoplol): the project account
- [Telegram](https://t.me/zztop_lol): community chat

## Optional

- [Injective auction module](https://docs.injective.network/): the monthly buyback ZZAUCTION participates in
